metadata.title: On deformations of foliated complex analytic structures IV-1: Obstructed and unobstructed foliated deformations
metadata.abstract: We study obstructions of deformations of foliated complex analytic structures. We describe obstructions in terms of Cech resolutions. From foliated complex analytic families in Part I and unfolded complex analytic families in Part III, we deduce the integrability conditions. We identify infinitesimal deformations and obstructions in terms of Dolbeault resolutions or Dolbeault type bicomplexes from the integrability conditions. Then we describe the correspondences of infinitesimal deformations and obstructions between Cech resolutions, and Dolbeault resolutions or Dolbeault type bicomplexes.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 叶状复解析结构变形的阻碍描述
analysis.workSummary: 研究叶状复解析结构变形的阻碍，从Čech分解及既有叶状/展开复解析族导出可积条件，再以Dolbeault分解或双复形识别无穷小变形与阻碍。
analysis.breakthrough: 把两类分辨中的无穷小和阻碍数据建立对应。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列消失或无阻碍的具体充分条件，也未说明各族的正则性范围。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。157页PDF完整提取，全文披露/工具候选及点写AI、任意断行连字模型名型号、HyProver/Hunyuan/Danus补检未观察到生成式AI实际使用声明。

analysis.priorityReason: 复几何变形的基础框架，具体应用需正文辨认。
